messages.text:
"Create a 3D third-person sci-fi survival shooter called ASTARTES: ALIEN EXTERMINATION.

The player controls a heavily armored ASTARTES soldier fighting waves of alien creatures in a futuristic arena.

Gameplay: Third-person camera, smooth movement, aiming, shooting, reloading, sprinting, jumping and melee attacks.

Customization: Allow players to freely change armor colors, helmet, shoulders and armor pieces. Include black, white, red, purple, gold and silver.

Weapons: Assault rifles, shotguns, plasma guns, heavy machine guns, pistols and energy swords. Each weapon has different damage and fire rate.

Waves: Create 10 increasingly difficult waves, with different alien enemies. Wave 10 features a gigantic boss. Afterward, unlock endless survival mode.

Enemies: Fast crawlers, ranged aliens, armored brutes, elite hunters and giant bosses. Enemies must chase and attack the player.

Progression: Killing enemies grants XP and credits. Allow upgrades to health, armor, damage, strength, speed, accuracy and reload speed. Add a shop between waves to purchase weapons and upgrades.

Special abilities: Groundbreaker, a powerful ground slam; Overdrive, temporarily increases damage and speed; Aegis Shield, absorbs incoming damage.

Visuals: Dark cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, massive black futuristic power armor, detailed weapons, terrifying aliens, explosions and dramatic lighting.

Include a main menu, HUD, health bar, ammunition counter, wave counter, upgrade menu and game-over screen.

Make everything functional and playable, with saved progression whenever possible.

ASTARTES — THE END OF EXISTENCE.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
